source.note: The freeze construction branch adds only documentation, contract and split-path retarget files; it changes no algorithm code or canonical configuration. The frozen algorithm is exactly the state at 79f11b631688889bf5ffbeb3c16ef543a53f9973 (PR #101 merge).

detector_yolov8s.name: YOLOv8s
detector_yolov8s.resolved_via: tools/lib/live_defaults.sh PERCEPTION_DETECTOR_MODEL=yolov8s -> PERCEPTION_HAILO_HEF_PATH=$THESIS_ROOT/models/hef/yolov8s.hef; held-out capture uses tools/experiments/record_p027_heldout_sequence.sh -> tools/start_live_stack.sh --detector-model yolov8s

pinned_numerical_environment.use: Source this file before every deterministic architecture replay whose semantic digest or physical-v2 buckets are compared. It changes no algorithm, configuration or contract; it is a numerical-reproducibility pin only.

frozen_constants.constant_source_note: DEFAULT_STEP_S is imported from the frozen thesis_bringup.tim_mars package (covered by the algorithm commit and the final-comparison source_code_freeze); DEFAULT_MAX_OUTPUT_AGE_S is imported from thesis_bringup.freshness.py, hashed here.

evaluation_tooling.candidate_stream_verification: run_deterministic_tim_replay.py and run_deterministic_tracker_replay.py hard-verify each replay's frozen candidate-input stream SHA-256 against the value supplied on the command line (--expected-candidate-stream-sha256). For a held-out source the expected value is the SHA-256 of that sequence's own frozen detector/tracker candidate stream, recorded in the split v4 manifest at capture time; there is no cross-sequence expectation.
evaluation_tooling.event_or_reacquisition_evaluator: NOT part of the retained Issue #27 contract. The frozen held-out evaluation is the physical-v2 identity-bucket evaluator above. Reacquisition and interval-level figures are DERIVED descriptive analysis over the frozen physical-v2 reference segments plus the frozen per-sample scoring (see primary_metric_contract); no additional evaluator is frozen or required.

architecture_comparison_contract.note: Extends tim_mars_final_comparison_v2_2026_09_05 with only the AB-16-driven canonical config hash/size and the frozen algorithm commit; architecture arms, models, evaluator, buckets and bootstrap rule are unchanged. Its own source_code_freeze.required_unchanged_paths list is the authoritative behaviour-bearing path set.

runtime_provenance_requirements.description: Every held-out architecture replay must retain a machine-readable provenance record with at least the following fields before any outcome is inspected.
required_fields: source_commit (git HEAD at replay time; must equal 79f11b631688889bf5ffbeb3c16ef543a53f9973 for a final held-out run)
repo_dirty (must be false for a final held-out run)
pinned_environment_sha256 and the effective pinned environment variable values
input_sequence_identifier (split v4 sequence id, e.g. heldout_h01_exit_reentry)

repeated_source_adaptive_update.{requested_production_policy,development_ablation_control,effective_suppression,activation_source} (must be requested_production_policy=true, development_ablation_control=false, activation_source='production_config' for a final held-out TIM-MARS run)
output_bag_path and generated semantic digest schema/value
evaluator_files and their sha256 (physical_target_reference_v2.py, physical_target_bbox_evaluation_v2.py, evaluate_physical_target_bbox_v2.py)

primary_metric_contract.evaluated_stream: /target_memory_mars (TIM selected-target) for TIM-MARS; the arm's controller-facing selected-target stream otherwise
primary_metric_contract.reconciliation_rule: All primary duration buckets must reconcile against the full physical-v2 evaluation window per the frozen v2 reference-gap and unavailable-reference semantics (reconciliation.ok=true, residual_s within evaluator tolerance).

target_presence_accounting.physical_target_present_duration_s: correct_target_output_duration_s + wrong_person_output_duration_s + identity_unresolved_duration_s + lost_or_suppressed_duration_s (the reference-covered, physically-scored target-present time)

while_physical_target_absent.leakage_pct_of_absent_time: 100 * target_absent_with_output_duration_s / target_absent_duration_s  (reported only when target_absent_duration_s > 0; otherwise 'not applicable')

reacquisition_derivation.authority: the frozen physical-v2 reference identity_state segments (present_scored vs absent) plus the frozen per-sample scoring at DEFAULT_STEP_S; no additional evaluator is frozen
reacquisition_derivation.valid_disappearance_return_event: a maximal run of identity_state='absent' samples in the frozen reference that is bounded on both sides by identity_state='present_scored'. The 'return instant' is the first present_scored sample after that absent run.
reacquisition_derivation.successful_reacquisition: correct-target authority (per the frozen scoring) is held at some sample at or after the return instant and before the evaluation-window end.
reacquisition_derivation.reacquisition_latency_s: (first sample time at which correct-target authority is held at or after the return instant) - (return instant). Reported per valid event.
reacquisition_derivation.right_censored_event: a valid disappearance/return event for which correct-target authority is never held again before the evaluation-window end. Its latency is reported as right-censored (>= window_end - return_instant); it is NOT assigned a finite latency and is excluded from any summary-latency statistic.
reacquisition_derivation.summary_latency: computed only over non-censored successful events; if any event is censored this is reported alongside the censored count, never as a single completed figure.

identity_safety_reporting.wrong_person_intervals: descriptive: maximal runs of samples scored wrong_person in the frozen per-sample scoring; each interval's [start_s, end_s, duration_s] reported
identity_safety_reporting.identity_switch_events: descriptive: a transition in the frozen per-sample scoring from correct_target to wrong_person without an intervening lost_or_suppressed sample; reported where the reference supports it
identity_safety_reporting.authority_to_non_designated_person: any non-zero wrong_person_output_duration_s or target_absent_with_output_duration_s is an explicit finding

development_percentage_characterisation.purpose: Descriptive only. The same presence-conditioned percentages may be computed for the retained development sequences (dev_may_hard_reentry, dev_june_seq01, dev_june_seq03_ocsort, dev_june_seq04_ocsort) from their existing frozen physical-v2 references, using the identical derivation above and no change to evaluator classification semantics.
fields: pct correct while physical target present
pct wrong while physical target present
pct suppressed while physical target present
pct leakage while physical target absent
must_not: be used to retune the algorithm
introduce any new optimisation or acceptance threshold
development_percentage_characterisation.known_retained_fact: dev_june_seq03_ocsort (Seq03 crossing) has zero physical target-absent duration; its leakage percentage is 'not applicable'.

success_failure_interpretation.quantitative_pass_threshold: None exists in the historical Issue #27 methodology and none is fabricated here. Results are interpreted, not reduced to a single scalar.
rules: wrong-person authority is always reported explicitly and is never compensated by higher correct-target availability
target-absence leakage is always reported explicitly
LOST/HOVER is an acceptable safe outcome under ambiguity or absence
no post-held-out parameter adjustment may be used to improve a failed result
an unfavourable held-out result remains valid thesis evidence

architecture_metric_validity.note: Raw tracker baselines have no selected-target identity policy; their identity buckets are computed with the same evaluator but interpreted as a lower reference, not as a controller capable of safe suppression. target_reid_090 is retained as a development-only negative arm (fixed 0.90 appearance threshold, stateless).

post_freeze_lock_rule.trigger: the first access or capture of any of H01/H02/H03 after this freeze is merged
post_freeze_lock_rule.post_access_software_bug: A serious software correctness bug found after held-out access must be documented. It must NOT be silently patched and re-run as though still prospective. Any corrected evaluation must be clearly identified as post-freeze / post-access evidence.
post_freeze_lock_rule.recapture_policy: A held-out physical capture may be repeated only for prospectively-defined technical invalidity: corrupted or unfinalized recording, missing required topics (/camera/image_raw and /detections), unusable camera imagery, or objective failure to execute the predeclared physical scenario. A failed algorithmic performance result is NEVER grounds for recapture.
post_freeze_lock_rule.threshold_or_algorithm_change_after_acce: contaminates the accessed H01/H02/H03 recordings; they must leave the final held-out set and a further explicitly versioned prospective split is required.

notes: This is the prospective freeze. It is created and merged BEFORE any H01/H02/H03 source is captured, listed, opened, hashed, replayed, annotated, evaluated or inspected.
No held-out outcome information exists or was used. The release gate remains fail-closed at final_ready=0/3.
Issue #27 must remain OPEN. The held-out evaluation has not occurred.
